correctness.rationale: For each triple, the proof first identifies the exact image modulo every power of three. It proves 2 is a generator of the ternary unit groups via v_3(2^(2*3^j)-1)=j+1; four ternary images are full and the two others exclude exactly one class modulo three. Separating parity by the last odd- or even-producing generator gives every listed congruence condition, including the k=1 exceptions. The numbers 4*3^(k-1), (3^(k+1)+1)/2, and 8*3^(k-2) are counted from disjoint residue classes, not inferred from experiments. The extracted checker independently confirms all 54 complete image-set equalities for k=1..9. Limitation: no claim about ordinary asymptotic density.

value.rationale: The six triples are the complete natural critical free family singled out in the 2025 source, and their integer-orbit density problem is mathematically motivated. Exact finite-quotient classifications provide local arithmetic obstructions and distinguish three genuinely different limiting modular occupancy fractions; they are not an arbitrary sample, a single tiny numerical improvement, or a merely renamed known case. The new 4/9 and 2/3 branches refine the qualitative obstruction information available for the related 3/4 case. The result does not settle natural density; this is a meaningful limitation, not an asserted application.
